items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: I knew him. I don't remember that I knew him as a song plugger.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Do you remember a song plug I thought of? Dave Frank. He used to run the music department at Whirlines in late years.
I knew him. I don't remember that I knew him as a song plugger.
Well, his son told me about it. And so I sent him a list of questions. Like he actually knew the man who wrote 12th Street Rag.
